title: Cold molecular outflows in the local Universe and their feedback effect on galaxies
question: How do molecular outflow properties in local star-forming and AGN galaxies scale with SFR, AGN luminosity and stellar mass, and can outflows clear galaxies of gas?

what.value: Molecular outflow properties for 31 literature galaxies (CO)

evidence.quote: We have compiled a total of 31 galaxies with published molecular outflows (five of which are upper limits).

external_data.citation: Cicone et al. (2014) and others, see Table 2

evidence.quote: Rupke & Veilleux (2013) provide ionized gas masses for four galaxies

external_data.citation: Rupke & Veilleux (2013); Greene et al. (2012); Arribas et al. (2014)

what.value: Neutral outflows from NaI D and [CII]

evidence.loc: 2.6 Neutral Outflows from Na I D
evidence.quote: We crossmatch our sample with Rupke & Veilleux (2013) and Cazzoli et al. (2016)

external_data.citation: Rupke & Veilleux (2013); Cazzoli et al. (2016); Janssen et al. (2016)

recipe.goal: Detect outflow signature in integrated CO spectrum
recipe.method: Fit single vs double Gaussian; two Gaussians preferred if reduced chi2 drops by >=10 per cent, plus visual check of narrow/broad components
key_parameters: sigma_narrow <~100 km/s; sigma_broad ~100 to several 100 km/s

recipe.goal: Derive outflow mass, velocity, radius, rate
recipe.method: Broad-component flux to L'CO then M = alpha_CO L'CO; v_outf = FWHM_broad/2 + |v_broad - v_narrow|; radius = deconvolved major-axis FWHM/2 of 2D Gaussian fit to wing map; Mdot = v M / r
assumptions: alpha_CO = 0.8 Msun/(K km/s pc^2); CO thermalised and optically thick so L'CO(3-2)=L'CO(2-1)=L'CO(1-0)

recipe.method: AGN luminosity from X-ray via Marconi+04 bolometric correction, or [OIII], or mid-IR alpha_bol; SFR from LIR (Kennicutt & Evans 2012, AGN-corrected); stellar masses from K/J/H-band with colour M/L (Bell+03); gas masses from CO(1-0) with alpha_CO 0.8/1.2/4.4
Linear regression with linmix including x/y errors and upper limits; multi-parameter fit of Mdot vs SFR, L_AGN, M* minimising dispersion
assumptions: Candidate fossil outflows excluded from the multi-parameter fit

recipe.goal: Escape fraction from galaxy and halo
recipe.method: McIntosh+05 size-mass relation, Hernquist profile escape velocity; NFW halo with Moster+13 and Duffy+08; fraction of broad wing above v_esc

answer_key.quantity: SF galaxies fit: log Mdot vs log SFR slope and intercept
Multi-parameter fit exponent on stellar mass (molecular)

the momentum rate ranges from 1 to 30 times _L_ AGN / _c_
the fraction of outflowing gas with a high enough velocity to escape the galaxy and the dark matter halo is less than 5 per cent
